Attached: 1 image

A payment your software completes without you present is still your payment. A standing order is autonomous and nobody worries about it, because amount, payee and schedule were fixed when it was set up. An agent given a budget and a goal is also autonomous, and almost nothing about the transaction was fixed in advance. The narrower the configuration, the less anybody has to decide afterwards.
https://contraco.net/autonomous-payments.html
